Description:
## Overview

Implement the Pocket feature to enable users to organize their financial accounts (savings, loans, shares) into a unified pocket view.

## User Stories

1. View Pocket Dashboard - See all linked accounts with aggregated balance
2. Link Accounts - Add savings/loan/share accounts to pocket
3. Delink Accounts - Remove accounts from pocket
4. Access Account Details - Quick navigation to individual account details

## API Endpoints

- GET /self/pockets - Retrieve linked accounts
- POST /self/pockets?command=linkAccounts - Link accounts
- POST /self/pockets?command=delinkAccounts - Remove accounts

## Reference

- Pocket API: https://sandbox.mifos.community/fineract-provider/swagger-ui/index.html#/Pocket
- Link Accounts API: https://demo.mifos.io/api-docs/apiLive.htm#linkaccountstopocket

## Screen: Pocket Dashboard

**Purpose:** Display linked accounts with aggregated balance

**Entry Point:** Home > Pocket card tap

### Features
- Total aggregated balance from all linked accounts
- List of linked accounts grouped by type
- Account name, masked number, and balance for each
- Pull-to-refresh support
- Empty state when no accounts are linked

### UI Components
- TopAppBar with back button and manage action
- Aggregated balance card
- Linked accounts LazyColumn
- Account item cards with icon, name, masked number, balance
- Link More Accounts CTA button

### Actions
- Back → Navigate back
- Manage (gear icon) → Manage Pocket screen
- Account tap → Account Details
- Link More → Link Accounts screen

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Display total balance from all linked accounts
- [ ] Show loading state while fetching
- [ ] Handle empty state with CTA to link accounts
- [ ] Support pull-to-refresh

## Screen: Manage Pocket

**Purpose:** Add/remove accounts from pocket

**Entry Point:** Pocket Dashboard > Manage

### Features
- Two sections: Linked Accounts and Available to Link
- Remove button for each linked account
- Link button for available accounts
- Swipe-to-remove gesture support (optional)

### UI Components
- TopAppBar with back button
- Section headers
- Account item cards with action buttons

### Actions
- Back → Navigate back
- Remove → Delink confirmation dialog
- + Link → Link Account flow

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Show all linked accounts with remove option
- [ ] Show available accounts with link option
- [ ] Filter out already-linked accounts from available list
- [ ] Update UI immediately after link/delink

## Screen: Link Accounts (Bottom Sheet)

**Purpose:** Select accounts to link to pocket

**Entry Point:** Manage Pocket > + Link OR Pocket Dashboard > Link More

### Features
- Search field for filtering accounts
- Grouped list by account type (Savings, Loans, Shares)
- Multi-select checkboxes
- Sticky bottom Link Selected button with count

### API Call
POST self/pockets?command=linkAccounts
Body: {
  savingsAccounts: [123, 456],
  loanAccounts: [789],
  shareAccounts: []
}

### Actions
- Back → Navigate back (discard selection)
- Checkbox → Toggle account selection
- Link Selected → API call → Success screen

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Fetch all client accounts
- [ ] Filter out already-linked accounts
- [ ] Group accounts by type
- [ ] Support multi-select
- [ ] Show selected count on button
- [ ] Call API with selected IDs

## Screen: Delink Confirmation (Bottom Sheet Dialog)

**Purpose:** Confirm account removal from pocket

**Type:** Bottom Sheet Dialog

### Features
- Warning icon and title
- Account details being removed
- Reassurance message (account still accessible from main list)
- Remove and Cancel buttons

### API Call
POST self/pockets?command=delinkAccounts
Body: {
  savingsAccounts: [123],
  loanAccounts: [],
  shareAccounts: []
}

### Actions
- Remove → API call → Success → Refresh list
- Cancel → Dismiss sheet

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Show account details being removed
- [ ] Call delink API on confirm
- [ ] Refresh parent list after success
- [ ] Handle API errors gracefully

```kotlin
}
```
